title: Clippy Pet
description: An unofficial animated paperclip pet for the ChatGPT desktop app and Codex CLI. Nine animation states, sixteen look directions, one-line install on every Unix.

items.title: Clippy Pet 1.1: one-line install on every Unix
items.content_html: Clippy Pet 1.1 brings a one-line install on every Unix, native macOS and Linux installers, verifiable releases, a v1 build for ChatGPT web, and this documentation site.

items.title: Why a paperclip, why now
items.content_html: On building a deliberately old-fashioned character to a modern spec, and why the most-mocked assistant of the 1990s is the right mascot for an AI coding agent.
